text: こんな　ところで　ねちゃって　しょーが　ないわね！

structure.jp: こんな　ところで　ねちゃって
structure.en: falling asleep in a place like this

structure.jp: しょーが　ないわね！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says something happened fully and it's a bother. ねちゃって = 'he's gone and fallen asleep, and'.
